messages.en:
{07 16 00}Could you be any slower,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}? I mean,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
I caught myself
{07 14 00}{04 1a 00}{01 00 00 05 00}
eons ago. 
{07 0d 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}don't feel too bad.
I'm pretty much the
greatest that ever lived.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kas aeglasem enam saakski,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}? Ma mõtlen,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Ma püüdsin ise
{07 14 00}{04 1a 00}{01 00 00 05 00}
igavesti ammu.
{07 0d 00}Noh, {01 00 00 05 00}ära liiga kurvasta.
Ma olen umbes parim,
kes kunagi elanud on.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Whoa{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 15 00}Not so fast there,
{04 1f 00}.

{07 00 00}I went ahead and got
{04 1a 00}{01 00 00 05 00}
way before you!
{07 14 00}You know what that means,
right? {01 00 00 0f 00}I beat you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}I'm not one to make a big
fuss over who won and who
lost.
{07 0a 00}But beating you makes me
especially happy,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ohoo{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 15 00}Pidurda pisut,
{04 1f 00}.

{07 00 00}Mina võtsin ja sain
{04 1a 00}{01 00 00 05 00}
ammu enne sind!
{07 14 00}Tead, mida see tähendab,
eks? {01 00 00 0f 00}Ma võitsin sind,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Ma ei tee suurt numbrit
sellest, kes võitis ja kes
kaotas.
{07 0a 00}Aga sinu võitmine teeb mind
eriti õnnelikuks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
